name: FineWeb polygon retrieval
storage_policy: Raw FineWeb, OSM PBFs, models, caches, checkpoints, logs, and generated run artifacts remain on the Seagate project volume; GitHub and Hugging Face contain code, documentation, metadata, and filtered public evidence.
versioning_policy: V1 through V10 are immutable. A changed rule or public output contract receives a new version and path; a genuinely different approach receives a new direction ID.
